scope: Finite primary-source method/cost review of five new first releases from November18, announced/reviewed November19. Not exhaustive Agent literature coverage.
available_resource: One A100/A30 or local Mac; no paid API or model/data downloads for these diagnostics

reviews.scope: The local slice implements typed Evidence/Requirement delivery, covers resolution for verified consolidations, and a pure merge_eligible decision bound to head and RFC. It does not implement user simulation, semantic Triage/Architect/PM judgments, a coding agent or actual git merging. Typed fields cannot prove their strings contain no hidden answers; this remains L0, not a semantic security claim.
reviews.cost_basis: The main N=32 configuration records 1.92B tokens over five modification rounds, with a six-round schedule, multiple frontier APIs, 38 evaluation tasks and E2B sandboxes. A single GPU cannot cheaply reproduce these calls and environments. Only seconds-scale CPU protocol diagnostics run.

reviews.code_status: No paper-specific public source repository verified in fixed v1 or the reviewed project page; cited dependencies are not an author release.
reviews.scope: Trace stores nonnegative duration, GPU count, patch validity and evaluator test labels. cascade computes capped first-stage cost, cold-restart fallback and sequential latency. evaluate accepts complete matched pairs only. It handles synthetic trace arithmetic, not models, SWE-bench, a live timeout router or the paper's hidden-difficulty oracle router.
reviews.cost_basis: The complete campaign uses 36 models ×500 SWE-bench tasks, up to250 steps/two hours per task, MI300X multi-GPU serving and long contexts. It exceeds a single-GPU budget. Only seconds-scale CPU trace accounting runs, with no checkpoint or dataset downloads.

reviews.code_status: No paper-specific public source repository verified in fixed v1 or the reviewed project page; cited dependencies are not an author release.
reviews.scope: The local slice deduplicates13 template IDs, validates four plan conditions, and applies all seven operators with dependency renumbering after INSERT/PRUNE. Repairs are transactional and return only a valid final plan. Indices are zero based (paper k maps to k−1). Capabilities outside task policy are rejected; the separate explicit-user-grant extension, LLM planner, MCP gateway, retry scheduler and Cintra environment are absent.
reviews.cost_basis: The full multi-model ×14-task ×14-attack and ablation campaign needs real planners, gateways and multi-agent inference. One GPU cannot faithfully substitute the frontier-service matrix. Only seconds-scale deterministic CPU controls run, without APIs or model downloads.

reviews.scope: The local slice implements evaluator Replay records, maximum-category-risk admission, persistent veto, minimum/completion checks, both strict-majority confirmation protocols, and rollback gain retention including its zero-gain convention. It does not implement Willow/Kicker, email tools, attack search, LLM repair, a semantic judge, verification rollouts or OAuth fixes. Replay records belong only to the offline evaluator, not the actor.
reviews.cost_basis: The full study needs real multi-model APIs,29 case families, repeated search/rollback and up to two repairs; Appendix F records2895 development/final samples and relies on a Willow runtime without a verified public release. Only seconds-scale CPU evaluator arithmetic runs, with no personal services or model calls.

reviews.scope: Only primary review, cost assessment, bilingual documentation and learning material are delivered. An OCI schema stub, arbitrary microbenchmark or small single-GPU model is not labeled an RSIBench-Infra integration. local_operator=null and no executable evolve operator is advertised. The project page https://rsibench-infra.github.io is verified, but no paper-specific public source repository was verified.
reviews.cost_basis: Twenty tasks require1–32 accelerators/up to four nodes,1.7B–2.8T inference models and7B–30B BF16 full-parameter training. Each agent run allows eight hours, followed by quality replay and measurement. These configurations already exceed a single A100/A30 budget; no costly probe is launched to establish that fact.
